steps.text: Rhodes Island Landship, Common Rest Area Passageway

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: The end.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: That's it?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: When's the next episode?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I'll ask.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Shamare, when can we watch 'Felitubbies' episode 20?

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Zzzz...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Looks like she fell asleep while we were watching.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: She's been doing that a lot.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Isn't 'Felitubbies' fun though?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Spot says it's for kids.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Maybe Shamare got too big for it?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: No way!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: She's only a few years older than us! Just two episodes ago, she was with us for the whole thing! How could she fall asleep on us this time?!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: We'll grow up really, really soon too. Maybe we'll be grown-ups by the time we finish the show.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: What do you want to do when you grow up, Bubble?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Me? I'm gonna go back to my tribe and beat up everyone I don't like and become a great warrior!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: What 'bout you?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I wanna be a superhero. I'll knock out bad guys with one punch, shoot eye lasers, and fly through the sky.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Do superheroes really exist?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I've never seen anyone shoot beams out their eyes or anyone who knows how to fly.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I know lots who beat up bad guys, though.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Like me.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: That's just what I want to become...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: My eye has been sick for so long, I've been thinking how cool it would be if I could shoot lasers out of my eyes like a superhero.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I hope you get better! I want to see both your eyes!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: When my bad eye gets better, you'll be the first one to see it.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Really?! Hooray!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: What time is it?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Orchid told us we could play for two hours. We only have half an hour left.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Why only two hours? Can't we play all hours?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: We have training and school. We need to do our homework, too. The teacher will be mad if we don't.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Why do we have to do homework?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: We need to study hard. That's what the adults always tell us.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I've been running all around the ship every day. I've never heard anything about homework.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: And um, what is homework actually? Is it tasty?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I don't think you can eat it. Homework's—Hm... I'm not sure what exactly homework is either. I just know you get smarter if you do it.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Why don't you give it a try?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Is this homework?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: It's just a book.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Did you draw all these things?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Most of them.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But the red ink ones are the teacher.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I don't get it at all.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Ugh, you can have it back.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: If they make me learn this stuff, I'm gonna jump off the ship and run straight home to Papa in Sargon.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: And if anyone stands in my way, I'll trample them!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I heard what happened with that lady from Minos a few days ago—

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Nothing happened! You heard wrong!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: That Forte's not so strong!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I smashed her into the ground easy!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Uh-huh.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Really! I did!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: If you swear on your Papa, I'll believe you.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Fine! I will!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I, Bubble, swear by Papa's name... that I couldn't beat the Minoan Forte lady.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: So you lied. It did happen.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Don't tell anyone! I'm really not so weak, really really!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: The Forte lady is just way too strong!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay, I see. You tell the truth every time you swear.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: W-What can I do? Papa said that if you swear something by someone's name, that person'll hear it!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: If Papa finds out I lied, he'll whoop my butt so hard!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: So if I swear something by my dad's name, will he hear what I say too?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I dunno. Why don't you try?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: My dad. His name—

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I don't remember his name.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: What about your mama? That works too.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I don't remember hers either.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Auntie Kal'tsit said I was sculpted out of clay.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But I think I had parents too.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Everyone else has parents. There's no way I don't.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Maybe the white coat doctor was lying to you?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I don't think Auntie Kal'tsit lies.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: The Feline doctor, right? I can tell from the look on her face, she's a bad woman. Not like my shaman grandpa back home. He's always smiling. One look at him and you know he's nice.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Being quiet doesn't make someone a baddie.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Look at Shamare.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Shamare always looks really cold too, but she takes care of everyone.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: That one time you ate a cactus and got needles all stuck in your mouth, she was the one who knocked you out cold and plucked out every last one before she turned you over to the doctors.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: And she knows how to pick good apples. Her apples are so big, sweet, and tasty.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: You're right. She does bring us really tasty apples.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Okay, I believe you. Shamare's not a baddie, and that doctor isn't a baddie either.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: But if no one's bad, and the doctor didn't lie to you, then how come you don't remember your mama or your papa?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Maybe it's because I have a bad memory. I forget lots of things.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But there are things I won't forget.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: The banging sounds in the mines, the big steel cities, way bigger than Rhodes Island, and the towers surrounded by tons of people.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: There was a doctor wearing a big white coat, a bunch of glittering chunks of steel, and a small, quiet room.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: There was also a big white room with a bed inside.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Sounds like you remember a lot, actually.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But I don't remember my mom and dad's names...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Maybe you'll remember when you get your head knocked around. That's how I usually remember things.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I can give you a good whack, if you want!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I'm really strong!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Whap whap whap!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: You're too strong, Bubble. You'll smack me so hard I'll turn dumb.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Really? I guess I won't do that then.
Buzz, buzz.

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: This is boring. Look, Shamare's even talking in her sleep. Popukar, lemme play with your brum brum brrrrr thing a little.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay, but the brum brum brrrr thing won't go brrrr today.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: The thing that makes it go brrrr is being fixed.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: It broke when I was helping everyone else brrrr things.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I'll think of something else to play, then.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: You should spend less time on training and classes and play more like me, Popukar. That other stuff is boring.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But if we don't keep up with our training, we might get hurt when we go beat up the baddies.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Besides, I need to help out Orchid, and everyone else.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: You're such a goody two-shoes! You should be like me. Grab a shield and charge straight ahead.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: That's a good way to get hurt.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: When I started out, I didn't know what I was doing. I took my brum brum brrrr thing and swung it all over the place, and it got people hurt sometimes, people I didn't wanna hurt.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Then I started training and I learned to listen to Orchid. She does the thinking, and I do the listening.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: That way I won't get hurt, and neither does anybody else. I think it's a nice thing.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: The people you don't wanna hurt, are they strong? Like, as strong as Papa?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I don't think so, but they take good care of me.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Orchid combs my hair, and Midnight picks out clothes for me.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Catapult brings me tasty food, and Spot finds me fun comics to read.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Wow—That does sound nice! I should get the Doctor to find me some servants too.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: But how come you still chase them with your brum brum brrrr thing?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Brum brum brrrr thing? Chase who?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I wouldn't do that.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Shamare always says she's a big girl and so nobody's allowed to pat her head.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: But she actually gets all happy whenever she gets a headpat.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Shamare does?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Yep!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Oh, I have an idea! Shamare's tail is so much fun to play with. Wanna try?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: It's so smooth and soft. Not even the beast hide on Papa's throne is that smooth.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Shamare will get mad.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: She's asleep! She doesn't have to know!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But what if she wakes up?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Hrmph.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Let me think of something else...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: We could wrestle?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Orchid says we're not allowed to wrestle in the lounge. She says it could disturb someone's rest.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: You listen to everything she says? Sheesh...

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: I'll keep an eye... on her...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Poor Shamare. So bored she's talking in her sleep.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: There's gotta be something fun we can do...?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I got it!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Let's arm wrestle! That's safe enough, right?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: It's quiet, we get to see which one of us's stronger, and most importantly—

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: We've never done it before.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I guess.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Let's use this table, then. Come!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Ready?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Hmph!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Ahh!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I've never lost an arm wrestling match...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hnggh! Haah!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: By Papa's name!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I will never lose at arm wrestling!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Haah!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hyah!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: W-We broke the table...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: (Whispers) W-What do we do?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (Whispers) I dunno!

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Zzzz...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: That was close. But she's still asleep.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: If we woke her up, she'd curse me for sure.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: W-What about the table?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Let the janitor take care of it!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But what if the janitor asks? W-What do we tell him?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: We'll tell him it broke on its own!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: It's not good to lie...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I don't want a spanking!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Spankings are worse than lying!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: *Whimpers*...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Okay, when the adults show up, we'll tell them the table broke on its own. Okay?!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Hm, your eyepatch's tilted.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: There's something black inside...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: (Readjusts eyepatch hurriedly)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Is that black thing those bad rocks?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Maybe. I didn't touch it.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Orchid and Auntie Kal'tsit told me to never take my eyepatch off.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I don't remember...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Then let me take a look, okay? Just a peek. You can put it right back. It'll be fine.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I'll share my snacks with you. I got a really tasty box from the fat purple Vulpo girl last week.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: And it's your favorite wafers!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Deal?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Just a peek, though.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Hehe!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Mmm...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I-It's too bright...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Hold on! I'll turn off the lights!

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: (Opens eyes)...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Is it okay now?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: (Takes off eyepatch)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Whoa, that's so cool!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: It looks so nice, so cool!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: What is it like?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I dunno, but it's super cool.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Hm? Something looks kinda shiny inside.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Oh—

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Whoa, it's getting shinier!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Your eye's so awesome!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: It's kinda hot too.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Put your eyepatch on.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay, Shamare.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Hey, Shamare, what are you—

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Orchid's outside the door. Don't keep her waiting.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Orchid? Already? I gotta go!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But what about Bubble?

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: I'll take her back to the dorm.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Then I'll get going. See you!

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: See ya.

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Phew...
Buzz, buzz.

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Popukar is fine.

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: I'll bring Bubble right now.

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Let's go, Morte. We're dragging Bubble to Medical.

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: I hope she learned her lesson this time.

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Yes, drag. She's too heavy. We can't carry her.

steps.name: Shamare
steps.text: Let's go.
